style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 1.5m Pre Lit Once Upon a Star Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Do you want the beauty with the ease of artificial foliage? The 1.5m Pre Lit Once Upon a Star Christmas Garland offers a refreshing look with the enhanced aura of artificial lights. The 40 LEDs are dotted around the faux foliage to cast a soft glow, which helps you relax and gently uplifts you throughout the winter months. Turn off the big lights and let the little lights create a pleasant ambience. The pre-lit Christmas garland can be programmed to illuminate every evening at the same time, with the optional 6-hour timer. There is also a constant ‘on’ mode. The discreet clear cable blends into the background, showcasing the shine, which will help you through those dark evenings of winter. Bring inspiration to your home with the Once Upon a Star Christmas Garland. Let it inspire you to dream big into the New Year.
